summary.text: Pierre DuPont is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 20 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
DuPont owns a construction company, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Pierre Dupont lives in Manchester, New Hampshire.
He lost the Hillsborough 20 general election on November 8, 2022, and won it on November 5, 2024, defeating Joshua Query and Jose Marte.
